claim: The sample opens with a fixed Moon tide scene and never changes normal Wallpage data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter /demo, change and reset demo settings, start for real, and compare storage namespaces

claim: Each of the ten moving scenes is drawn in the browser without a video stream.
sandbox: enter through /demo, use a recorded positive Collector response, then require a sized and changing canvas with no media request for every scene

claim: The demo contacts only Wallpage and has no account, ads, analytics, cookies, or downloaded fonts.
sandbox: fresh demo context; intercept the complete sample flow and require same-origin requests, no cookies or account fields, and demo-prefixed storage only

claim: The gallery contacts Sociobot only when it checks a saved or entered Collector license.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: two fresh real-gallery contexts; assert no verifier request without a license and exactly one declared verifier request with a saved license

claim: The demo reopens offline after its first visit and keeps drawing its scene.
sandbox: fresh demo context; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and compare two later canvas frames

claim: The gallery contains eight free scenes and two Collector scenes.
sandbox: fresh demo context; open the scene library and count free and locked cards

claim: Collector costs $19 once and its two scenes unlock only after Sociobot verifies a license.
sandbox: enter through demo; assert price and external checkout, negative states, then use a recorded positive response and render both unlocked scenes

claim: Display settings control rotation, clock, date, brightness, night dimming, frame-rate cap, and local persistence.
sandbox: controlled time and timers in demo; verify every display result and demo-only storage, then verify normal settings use the normal same-origin key

claim: Share creates a link containing the active scene and fixed seed.
sandbox: fresh demo context with navigator.share stubbed; change scene and inspect the shared URL

claim: The fullscreen button and F key enter and leave fullscreen when supported.
sandbox: fresh demo context with the Fullscreen API stubbed; exercise the button and keyboard shortcut in both directions

claim: Gallery controls fade after 4.5 seconds and return on pointer movement.
sandbox: fresh demo context; time the visible-to-hidden state and restore it with pointer movement

claim: Keyboard shortcuts change scenes, pause playback, toggle the clock, and open settings and the guide.
sandbox: fresh demo context; exercise ArrowRight, Space, C, S, Escape, and H and assert each resulting state

claim: At 1280 by 720, the gallery works with keyboard-only controls and remains usable without fullscreen.
sandbox: fresh 1280 by 720 demo context; use only keyboard input, reject fullscreen, and assert the scene and recovery message remain usable

claim: Keep screen awake follows play and visibility state, while unsupported browsers keep the gallery usable.
sandbox: fresh demo contexts with supported and unsupported Wake Lock fixtures; exercise enable, pause, play, hidden, visible, and fallback states

claim: Visible demo controls have touch targets at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels at 390px width.
sandbox: fresh 390 by 844 demo context; measure every visible button and link

claim: Initial JavaScript is at most 200 KB, CSS files are at most 50 KB, and shipped scene images are at most 300 KB each.
sandbox: fresh production build; measure emitted initial JavaScript, CSS, AVIF, WebP, and JPEG files

claim: The production build type-checks and writes dist/index.html.
sandbox: fresh production build performed by test:claims; assert the built root HTML and deployment configuration exist
